LanguageData.Stickyfoam_GlobalSettings: Global settings for all colonies. Changes apply when this window closes.
LanguageData.Stickyfoam_DamageReductionInfo: Off by default: coated targets are easier to kill than with the original 25% damage reduction. This does not add armour.
LanguageData.Stickyfoam_SettingsApplyInfo: Speed, protection, ground beauty/cleanliness and cleaning work change on existing foam. Lifetimes apply to fresh coatings/hits and newly spawned ground foam; existing timers keep their remaining time. A removal job keeps the duration it started with. Seconds are game time.
